title: BaRe-Mem: Bayesian Reliability Memory for Robust and Adaptive Agent Consultation
title_zh: BaRe-Mem: 一种在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆用于多智能体咨询

paragraphs.en: In multi-agent systems, reliable consultation is challenging because advisor capabilities vary across tasks, and misleading information can make consultation worse than autonomous reasoning. We introduce BaRe-Mem , an online Bayesian reliability memory for multi-agent consultation. It estimates advisor reliability based on the central model’s internal belief representations and updates these estimates from historical interactions. These estimates modulate the influence of advisor responses and guide the choice between consultation and autonomous reasoning. Across nine benchmarks and six central models, BaRe-Mem is more robust to misleading advisor information than debate and majority voting. On the more challenging tasks, it remains above autonomous reasoning across all tested misleading levels. Moreover, we extend the BaRe-Mem mechanism to worker allocation in agent teams. On the MuSiQue benchmark, BaRe-Mem improves task completion over routing by historical success counts and identifies capable workers earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 在多智能体系统中，可靠的咨询过程具有挑战性，因为顾问的能力因任务而异，而误导性信息甚至可能使咨询效果比自主推理更差。 我们提出了 BaRe-Mem，一种用于多智能体咨询的在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆机制。 该机制基于中心模型的内部信念表示来评估顾问的可靠性，并通过历史交互不断更新这些评估结果。 这些评估结果会调节顾问回答的影响权重，并指导在咨询与自主推理之间的选择。 在九项基准测试和六个中心模型中，BaRe-Mem 对误导性顾问信息的鲁棒性优于辩论法和多数投票法。 在更具挑战性的任务中，即使在所有测试的误导性水平下，其表现仍优于自主推理。 此外，我们将 BaRe-Mem 机制扩展到了智能体团队中的工作者分配问题。 在 MuSiQue 基准测试中，BaRe-Mem 相比基于历史成功次数的路由方法能更有效地完成任务，并能更早地识别出能力强的工作者。

paragraphs.en: As no single large language model (LLM) can be expected to possess all the capabilities required for complex tasks ( Shen et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , AI systems are increasingly being organized as networks of interacting agents ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . These agents may consult other models ( Shen et al., 2023 ) , specialized services ( Song et al., 2023 ) , tools ( Qin et al., 2024 ) , or humans ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , drawing on capabilities that lie outside their own parameters. This makes reliable consultation a fundamental problem: an agent must determine not only what other sources provide but also how much their information should influence its own decision.

paragraphs.en: Reliable consultation is necessary because advisor information can help as well as hurt ( Du et al., 2023 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . Recent work shows that exposure to misleading consultation can cause models to abandon initially correct answers, which reduces the performance of the agent seeking advice ( Song et al., 2025 ) . This risk is compounded by the heterogeneous and task-dependent capabilities of advisors: a model that is reliable on one domain may fail on another ( Smit et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) , while agreement among multiple advisors does not guarantee correctness when they reinforce the same plausible but erroneous solution ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Effective consultation therefore requires more than aggregating current responses: the central model must estimate which evidence in external information is reliable for the current question.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的咨询是必要的，因为顾问提供的信息既可能提供帮助，也可能造成误导（Du et al., 2023；Cui et al., 2026）。 近期的研究表明，接触误导性咨询可能导致模型放弃最初正确的答案，从而降低寻求建议的智能体的性能（Song et al., 2025）。 顾问能力的异质性和任务依赖性加剧了这一风险：一个在某个领域表现可靠的模型可能在另一个领域失效（Smit et al., 2023；Kim et al., 2026）；同时，当多个顾问一致强化同一个看似合理但错误的解决方案时，他们的共识并不保证正确性（Weng et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2025）。 因此，有效的咨询需要做的不仅仅是汇总当前的回答：中心模型必须能够判断外部信息中哪些证据对于当前问题而言是可靠的。

paragraphs.en: Repeated interaction history naturally provides such information. Existing methods preserve past experience either as textual memory, such as retrieved trajectories ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , distilled summaries ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and working skills ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , or as persistent continuous states that are updated across interactions ( Behrouz et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Bayat et al., 2026 ) . However, only retaining history is not enough. A reliable historical memory should turn past interactions into contextual estimates that regulate the influence of external information on the current decision ( Teacy et al., 2006 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . In order to remain effective over long horizon interactions, these estimates should scale with an expanding task stream, remain robust to misleading consultation, and adapt to changes in advisor reliability. Moreover, since collaboration can yield diminishing or even negative gains as single-agent capability becomes high enough ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Verma et al., 2026 ) , reliability should determine not only how external evidence influences the central model, but whether it should be utilized at all ( Eo et al., 2025 ; Verma et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . A robust reliability memory should therefore assess not only the advisors’ information reliability but also the central model ability itself, enabling it to determine whether external evidence is likely to improve upon its autonomous reasoning on the current question.
paragraphs.zh: 重复的交互历史天然就能提供这类信息。 现有方法将过往经验以文本记忆的形式保留下来，例如检索到的轨迹（Zhao 等，2024）、提炼出的摘要（Zhang 等，2025a）和工作技能（Yu 等，2026），或以持续更新的连续状态形式保留，这些状态会在多次交互中不断调整（Behrouz 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026；Feng 等，2026；Bayat 等，2026）。 然而，仅仅保留历史信息是远远不够的。 一个可靠的历史记忆应当将过往交互转化为情境性评估，从而调节外部信息对当前决策的影响（Teacy 等，2006；Zhou 等，2026）。 为了在长期交互中保持有效性，这些评估必须能够随着任务流程的扩展而调整，对误导性咨询保持稳健，并能适应顾问可靠性的变化。 此外，随着单智能体能力达到足够高的水平，协作可能带来的收益会逐渐减少甚至变为负值（Kim 等，2026；Verma 等，2026），因此可靠性不仅应决定外部证据如何影响核心模型，还应决定是否应当使用这些证据（Eo 等，2025；Verma 等，2026；Zhang 等，2025b）。 因此，一个稳健的可靠性记忆不仅应评估顾问提供的信息可靠性，也应评估核心模型自身的能力，从而判断外部证据是否有可能优于其针对当前问题的自主推理。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we introduce BaRe-Mem , an online Bayesian reliability memory for robust and adaptive multi-agent consultation. It models advisor reliability conditioned on the central model’s internal belief representations of the current question and candidate response. The memory maintains these estimates for both the central model and its advisors, updating them online from verified correctness outcomes. Advisor reliability estimates steer attention to peer responses. Additionally, it compares estimated consultation and autonomous ability to decide whether to consult. In the experiments, we show that BaRe-Mem remains robust as external information becomes increasingly misleading by adaptively shifting between consultation and autonomous reasoning. Its predicted consultation advantage is consistent with the real gain observed after verification, and useful reliability estimates emerge from sparse verified feedback. BaRe-Mem also improves worker selection in agent teams through verification feedback, extending its deployment scenarios beyond response level consultation.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 BaRe-Mem——一种在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆机制，用于实现稳健且自适应的多智能体咨询。 该机制将顾问的可靠性建模为以中心模型对当前问题和候选回答的内部信念表示为条件的概率。 该记忆机制同时维护中心模型及其顾问的这些估计值，并通过已验证的正确性结果在线更新它们。 顾问的可靠性估计值引导注意力聚焦于同伴的回答。 此外，它还会比较咨询能力与自主能力的估计值，以决定是否进行咨询。 在实验中，我们证明当外部信息变得越来越具有误导性时，BaRe-Mem 仍能保持稳健，因为它能在咨询与自主推理之间自适应地切换。 其预测的咨询优势与验证后观察到的实际收益一致，并且即使仅有稀疏的验证反馈，也能产生可靠的可靠性估计值。 BaRe-Mem 还通过验证反馈提升了智能体团队中的工作者选择效率，使其部署场景超越了回答层面的咨询范畴。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches construct memory through either explicit textual records or latent continuous memory states. Text-based systems store historical information externally or distill feedback and experience into reusable reflections, skills, and trajectories ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Despite their flexibility, textual memories are constrained by compression fidelity and retrieval noise ( Laban et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, continuous memory approaches encode past experience into persistent latent states, neural memory, generated memory tokens, or structured competence states that can be updated across interactions ( Wu et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Behrouz et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Bayat et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches do not explicitly model an advisor’s reliability estimation conditioned on the central model’s internal belief of the context.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过显式文本记录或潜在连续记忆状态来构建记忆。 基于文本的系统将历史信息存储在外部，或将反馈和经验提炼为可重用的反思、技能和轨迹（Shinn 等，2023；Packer 等，2023；Zhong 等，2024；Zhao 等，2024；Chhikara 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025a）。 尽管具有灵活性，文本记忆仍受压缩保真度和检索噪声的限制（Laban 等，2026）。 与此同时，连续记忆方法将过往经验编码为持久的潜在状态、神经记忆、生成的记忆标记或结构化能力状态，这些状态可以在多次交互中不断更新（Wu 等，2022；Wang 等，2024b；Wang 等，2025b；Behrouz 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026；Wei 等，2026；Feng 等，2026；Bayat 等，2026；Cao 等，2026）。 然而，这些方法并未显式建模顾问的可靠性估计，而该估计应以中心模型对上下文的内部信念为条件。

paragraphs.en: Memory can steer model behavior through three broad interfaces: prompt conditioning, parameter adaptation, and internal-state modulation. Prompt-based approaches retrieve or summarize historical experience into textual prompts that guide subsequent reasoning ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Parameter-based approaches encode historical information into low-rank adaptations, allowing memory to alter subsequent computation while keeping the pretrained backbone fixed ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Charakorn et al., 2026 ) . Internal-state approaches instead inject memory directly into the model’s computation, through recurrent matrix states ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Team et al., 2025 ) , activation or residual modulation ( Lei et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) , or direct modification of attention logits or weights ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Guardieiro et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . We adopt attention modification because BaRe-Mem produces specific reliability estimates that can directly modulate the influence of each advisor’s response.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆可以通过三种主要接口来引导模型行为：提示条件设定、参数自适应以及内部状态调制。 基于提示的方法会检索或总结历史经验，将其转化为文本提示，从而指导后续的推理过程（Shinn 等，2023；Zhao 等，2024；Zhou 等，2026）。 基于参数的方法则将历史信息编码为低秩自适应模块，使记忆能够改变后续的计算过程，同时保持预训练的骨干模型不变（Wang 等，2024a；Charakorn 等，2026）。 而基于内部状态的方法则直接将记忆注入模型的计算流程中，具体方式包括循环矩阵状态（Yang 等，2024；Team 等，2025）、激活或残差调制（Lei 等，2026；Feng 等，2026），以及对注意力 logits 或权重的直接修改（Zhang 等，2024；Guardieiro 等，2025；Yan 等，2025；Deng 等，2025）。 我们采用注意力修改方法，因为 BaRe-Mem 能够生成特定的可靠性估计值，从而直接调节每位顾问响应的影响力。

paragraphs.en: We conduct our study under two complementary capability regimes. The capability-supported suite includes mathematical reasoning (GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) ), code generation (APPS ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) ), and retrieval-based question answering (SQuAD ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) ), where most evaluated central models exhibit relatively strong competence and useful advisor information is broadly available. The capability-challenging suite includes physical commonsense reasoning (PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2020 ) ), broad knowledge (MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2020 ) ), science question answering (OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) and SciQ ( Welbl et al., 2017 ) ), complex reasoning (BBH ( Suzgun et al., 2023 ) ), and language understanding (SuperGLUE ( Wang et al., 2019 ) ), where capabilities are substantially more heterogeneous and task-dependent across models. We utilize six advisors and evaluated six central models, their individual performance is reported in Appendix B.1 . Within each capability regime, questions from the constituent datasets are randomly shuffled to prevent the memory from exploiting dataset order as a shortcut for advisor reliability. In the main text, we use Qwen3-14B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Phi-4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) as representative central models for analysis. Additional results are provided in the Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: Obs.1. Consultation robustness depends on the capability regime. Figure 2 shows a clear contrast between the two capability regimes. In the capability-supported regime, Question + Peers and Debate (2 rounds) remain relatively stable as the misleading information ratio increases . In the capability-challenging regime, however, both degrade substantially and fall below the No consultation baseline once the misleading information ratio exceeds 50 % 50\% for both central models. This contrast is consistent with prior findings that the benefits of multi-agent interaction depend strongly on task and model capabilities ( Smit et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Majority voting is substantially more vulnerable : both variants deteriorate rapidly as misleading information becomes dominant. Incorporating the central model’s own answer partially mitigates this degradation, but does not prevent it, consistent with prior observations that models can abandon correct judgments in favor of incorrect peer majorities ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 观察 1。 咨询的稳健性取决于能力水平。 图 2 显示两种能力水平之间存在明显差异。 在能力支持型水平中，随着误导性信息比例的增加，“问题 + 同伴”和“辩论（2 轮）”的表现保持相对稳定。 然而，在能力挑战型水平中，一旦误导性信息比例超过 50%，这两种方法都会显著下降，并低于“无咨询”基准线（对于两种中心模型而言）。 这种差异与先前的研究结果一致，即多智能体互动的益处高度依赖于任务和模型的能力（Smit 等，2023；Kim 等，2026）。 多数投票法明显更脆弱：随着误导性信息占据主导地位，两种变体都会迅速恶化。 引入中心模型自身的答案可以部分缓解这种性能下降，但无法完全阻止，这与先前的观察结果一致，即模型可能会为了迎合错误的同伴多数而放弃正确的判断（Weng 等，2025；Zhu 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Obs. 2. Reliability consultation helps but still requires autonomous reasoning. Advisors + memory is an ablation of BaRe-Mem that retains reliability guided attention but removes the autonomous option, forcing the model to consult on every question. Advisors + memory substantially improves robustness over Question + Peers , indicating that historical reliability estimates make consultation less sensitive to misleading advisor responses. In the capability-supported regime, this is often sufficient to maintain stable performance. However, in the capability-challenging regime, its accuracy eventually falls below the No consultation baseline as misleading information becomes dominant for both central models. This exposes a limitation of relative advisor weighting: it can determine whom to trust more, but not whether the advisor pool is worth consulting as a whole . BaRe-Mem adds this missing gap by comparing estimated consultation and autonomous abilities on each question, and remains above the No consultation baseline across all tested misleading information ratios. These results show that our BaRe-Mem helps the central model not only estimate source reliability, but also choose to rely on itself when external evidence is collectively unreliable.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 2。 可靠性咨询虽有帮助，但仍需自主推理。 “顾问+记忆”是 BaRe-Mem 的一种简化版本，它保留了由可靠性引导的注意力机制，但移除了自主选项，迫使模型在回答每个问题时都必须进行咨询。 “顾问+记忆”相比“问题+同伴”显著提升了稳健性，这表明历史可靠性评估使咨询过程对误导性顾问回答的敏感度降低。 在能力支持模式下，这通常足以维持稳定的性能。 然而，在能力挑战模式下，随着误导性信息对两个中心模型都变得占主导地位，其准确性最终会低于“无咨询”基线水平。 这暴露了相对顾问权重的一个局限性：它虽然能决定更信任谁，却无法判断整个顾问池是否值得被咨询。 BaRe-Mem 通过在每个问题上比较咨询与自主能力的估计值，填补了这一缺失环节，并且在所有测试的误导性信息比例下，其性能始终高于“无咨询”基线。 这些结果表明，我们的 BaRe-Mem 不仅帮助中心模型评估来源可靠性，还能在外部证据整体不可靠时选择依赖自身。

sents.zh: “顾问+记忆”相比“问题+同伴”显著提升了稳健性，这表明历史可靠性评估使咨询过程对误导性顾问回答的敏感度降低。

sents.en: In the capability-supported regime, this is often sufficient to maintain stable performance.
sents.zh: 在能力支持模式下，这通常足以维持稳定的性能。

sents.en: However, in the capability-challenging regime, its accuracy eventually falls below the No consultation baseline as misleading information becomes dominant for both central models.
sents.zh: 然而，在能力挑战模式下，随着误导性信息对两个中心模型都变得占主导地位，其准确性最终会低于“无咨询”基线水平。

sents.en: This exposes a limitation of relative advisor weighting: it can determine whom to trust more, but not whether the advisor pool is worth consulting as a whole .
sents.zh: 这暴露了相对顾问权重的一个局限性：它虽然能决定更信任谁，却无法判断整个顾问池是否值得被咨询。

sents.en: BaRe-Mem adds this missing gap by comparing estimated consultation and autonomous abilities on each question, and remains above the No consultation baseline across all tested misleading information ratios.
sents.zh: BaRe-Mem 通过在每个问题上比较咨询与自主能力的估计值，填补了这一缺失环节，并且在所有测试的误导性信息比例下，其性能始终高于“无咨询”基线。

sents.en: These results show that our BaRe-Mem helps the central model not only estimate source reliability, but also choose to rely on itself when external evidence is collectively unreliable.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，我们的 BaRe-Mem 不仅帮助中心模型评估来源可靠性，还能在外部证据整体不可靠时选择依赖自身。

paragraphs.en: In realistic deployments, verified outcomes may be costly or only intermittently available. We therefore examine how efficiently BaRe-Mem learns reliability from sparse feedback by varying the fraction of questions whose verified outcomes are written to memory. As shown in Figure 5 , both Qwen3-14B and Phi-4 benefit substantially from even a small amount of verified feedback . The magnified region below 1 % 1\% (approximately 170 samples) shows clear gains over the no-feedback setting, indicating that useful reliability estimates emerge after only a small number of verified interactions. Performance improves rapidly as feedback becomes available and then largely saturates, with most of the eventual gain obtained well before full feedback is provided. These results show that BaRe-Mem can learn useful reliability information without requiring dense verification.

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate BaRe-Mem in a realistic multi-agent team setting. A lead agent decomposes each task into sub-tasks, routes each sub-task to a worker, and replans by trying another worker when the returned report is rejected. The pipeline is shown in Figure 22 . We conduct this evaluation on MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) , which contains 2,417 tasks and 6,404 sub-tasks. In this setting, BaRe-Mem is no longer used to reweight a fixed set of candidate responses. Instead, it is used to decide which worker should receive each sub-task and which worker should be tried at first .

paragraphs.en: To further understand why BaRe-Mem improves agent-team routing, we examine how quickly the lead agent can identify a worker capable of solving each sub-task. In this experiment, the dataset verifier checks the returned report after every worker call. If the checker returns a failure signal, the lead agent proceeds to the next ranked worker until the sub-task is solved or all candidates are exhausted. As shown in Figure 7 , all routing strategies approach the same ceiling once every worker has been tried. However, BaRe-Mem reaches higher task completion with fewer worker calls , showing that its reliability memory helps the lead agent identify capable workers earlier in the search process. These results demonstrate that BaRe-Mem extends naturally beyond response attention to practical worker routing in realistic multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步理解 BaRe-Mem 为何能提升智能体团队的路线规划，我们研究了主智能体能够多快地识别出可解决每个子任务的执行者。 在此实验中，数据集验证器会在每次调用执行者后检查返回的报告。 如果检查器返回失败信号，主智能体将继续尝试下一个排名靠前的执行者，直到子任务被解决或所有候选执行者都被尝试完毕。 如图 7 所示，一旦所有执行者都被尝试过，所有路线规划策略都会趋近于相同的上限。 然而，BaRe-Mem 以更少的执行者调用实现了更高的任务完成率，这表明其可靠性记忆有助于主智能体在搜索过程中更早地识别出有能力执行任务的执行者。 这些结果表明，BaRe-Mem 能够自然地将其应用从响应注意力扩展到真实多智能体系统中的实际执行者路线规划。

paragraphs.en: We introduced BaRe-Mem , a Bayesian reliability memory that learns contextual source reliability from verified interaction history. By using reliability to both modulate advisor influence and decide whether consultation is preferable to autonomous reasoning, BaRe-Mem enables a central agent to adaptively determine whom to trust and whether to consult . Across heterogeneous tasks, it remains robust as advisor information becomes increasingly misleading, learns useful reliability from sparse feedback, and extends naturally to worker routing in agent teams. These results suggest that persistent reliability memory can provide a practical foundation for robust and adaptive consultation in long horizon multi-agent systems.

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows that BaRe-Mem improves every evaluated central model in both capability regimes . The gains are particularly pronounced in the capability-challenging regime, where model and advisor capabilities are more heterogeneous. paragraphs.en: Obs. 1. Historical reliability improves consultation across models. Across both capability regimes and all tested misleading information ratios, Advisors + memory a chieves higher accuracy than Question + Peers for every central model. At 50 % 50\% misleading information in the capability-challenging regime, adding reliability memory improves accuracy by 9.4 % 9.4\% , 12.6 % 12.6\% , and 9.1 % 9.1\% percentage points for Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-14B, respectively. Since both methods consult on every question, this comparison demonstrates the benefit of incorporating historical reliability into the consultation process. The consistent gains support using accumulated correctness evidence to guide advisor influence rather than relying solely on the current responses.

paragraphs.en: Obs. 2. Autonomous selection complements reliability-guided consultation. The benefit of choosing whether to consult becomes particularly clear when misleading information dominates. At 100 % 100\% misleading information in the capability-challenging regime, Question + Peers , Debate (2 rounds) , and both majority voting baselines fall below No consultation for all six central models. Although Advisors + memory improves consultation, it also falls below the autonomous baseline under this condition. In contrast, BaRe-Mem exceeds its always consult ablation by 13.0 % 13.0\% – 34.6 % 34.6\% percentage points and remains 1.5 % 1.5\% – 2.8 % 2.8\% points above autonomous reasoning . Moreover, it stays above the autonomous baseline throughout the tested misleading information range in this regime for all six models. These results support the complementary roles of the two mechanisms: reliability-guided attention improves how advisor responses are used, while autonomous selection provides an alternative when continued consultation becomes harmful.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 2。 自主选择能够补充可靠性引导的咨询机制。 当误导性信息占主导地位时，是否选择咨询所带来的优势会变得尤为明显。 在能力挑战模式下，当误导性信息比例达到 100 % 100\% 时，“问题 + 同伴”、“辩论（2 轮）”以及两种多数投票基准模型在所有六个核心模型中的表现均低于“不咨询”。 尽管“顾问 + 记忆”机制提升了咨询效果，但在此条件下其表现也低于自主推理基准。 相比之下，BaRe-Mem 的表现比“始终咨询”的消融模型高出 13.0 % 13.0\% – 34.6 % 34.6\% 个百分点，并且仍比自主推理高出 1.5 % 1.5\% – 2.8 % 2.8\% 个百分点。 此外，在该模式下，对于所有六个模型而言，BaRe-Mem 在整个测试的误导性信息范围内始终高于自主推理基准。 这些结果支持了这两种机制的互补作用：可靠性引导的注意力机制优化了顾问响应的利用方式，而自主选择则在持续咨询变得有害时提供了替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Obs. 3. Consultation behavior adapts to the model and capability regime. The consultation ratios provide a behavioral explanation for these results. In the capability-supported regime, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Phi-4 maintain high consultation ratios, with endpoint decreases of only 1 % 1\% – 3 % 3\% points as misleading information increases from 0 % 0\% to 100 % 100\% . Qwen2.5-7B and Ministral-8B reduce consultation more noticeably, from 84 % 84\% to 77 % 77\% and from 85 % 85\% to 71 % 71\% , respectively, but still consult on most questions. In the capability-challenging regime, all six models exhibit a much stronger shift : consultation ratios decrease from 85 % 85\% – 90 % 90\% without injected misleading information to 9 % 9\% – 21 % 21\% at the highest misleading information ratio. Thus, the same increase in misleading information produces different consultation behavior across models and capability regimes. This pattern is consistent with comparing estimated consultation and autonomous abilities on each question, rather than applying a fixed consultation policy.

paragraphs.en: Checking and Feedback Protocol. We distinguish the check used to control retries from the feedback used to update reliability memory. We consider three checking settings: No check , where the first report is directly committed; Lead agent check , where the lead agent decides whether to accept the report or retry; and Dataset verifier check , where the dataset evaluator makes this decision. In all three settings, after a sub-task is committed, the gold correctness labels of all workers actually queried for that sub-task are written to memory, while unqueried workers receive no update. Thus, checking determines the execution path of the current sub-task, whereas verified feedback updates worker reliability for subsequent routing decisions. Memory is updated after each sub-task, allowing later sub-tasks to benefit from earlier verified outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 检查与反馈协议。 我们将用于控制重试的检查，与用于更新可靠性记忆的反馈区分开来。 我们考虑三种检查设置：无检查，即第一份报告被直接提交；主智能体检查，即由主智能体决定是否接受报告或重试；以及数据集验证器检查，即由数据集评估者做出这一决定。 在这三种设置中，子任务被提交后，实际为该子任务查询过的所有执行者的黄金正确性标签都会被写入记忆，而未查询的执行者则不会获得任何更新。 因此，检查决定了当前子任务的执行路径，而经过验证的反馈则会更新执行者的可靠性，以用于后续的路线决策。 每次子任务结束后都会更新记忆，这使得后续的子任务能够受益于早期已验证的结果。

paragraphs.en: Obs.1. Contextual reliability improves initial worker selection. The No check setting commits the first worker’s report without retrying, directly evaluating the initial assignment. In this setting, BaRe-Mem achieves higher sub-task completion than routing randomly or by historical success counts for all six lead models . The improvements are 5.0 % 5.0\% , 1.4 % 1.4\% , and 3.8 % 3.8\% points for Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-14B, respectively, and 5.6 % 5.6\% , 2.1 % 2.1\% , and 6.9 % 6.9\% points for Qwen2.5-7B, Ministral-8B, and Phi-4. Relative to random routing, it also improves task completion by 13.4 % 13.4\% – 17.8 % 17.8\% points across the six models. Because these gains arise without retries, they support the use of reliability conditioned on the current sub-task to identify a suitable worker at the initial assignment. The comparison with historical success counts further indicates that the benefit extends beyond simply retaining aggregate records of past success.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 1。 情境可靠性提升了初始智能体选择的效果。 “无检查”设置会直接采用首个智能体的报告，不再重试，从而直接评估初始分配结果。 在此设置中，BaRe-Mem 在所有六个领先模型上实现的子任务完成率均高于随机路由或基于历史成功次数的路由方法。 对于 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-14B，提升幅度分别为 5.0%、1.4% 和 3.8%；对于 Qwen2.5-7B、Ministral-8B 和 Phi-4，提升幅度分别为 5.6%、2.1% 和 6.9%。 与随机路由相比，该方法在所有六个模型上还将任务完成率提升了 13.4%–17.8%。 由于这些增益无需重试即可获得，因此支持利用基于当前子任务的可靠性指标，在初始分配阶段识别出合适的智能体。 与历史成功次数的对比进一步表明，这种优势并不仅限于简单地保留过去成功的汇总记录。

paragraphs.en: Obs.2. Reliability ranking complements verification in Agent Team Under Dataset verifier check , BaRe-Mem achieves the highest task and sub-task completion for every lead model . Task completion reaches 51.9 % 51.9\% – 55.0 % 55.0\% , exceeding historical success counts by 1.8 % 1.8\% – 4.9 % 4.9\% points and random routing by 9.1 9.1 – 11.4 11.4 points. paragraphs.en: Obs.3. The effect of report checking depends on the lead model. Lead agent checking improves BaRe-Mem’s task completion over No check for five of the six lead models, with gains of 1.5 % 1.5\% – 3.0 % 3.0\% points. Its effect is not uniform: with Ministral-8B, task completion changes from 41.6 % 41.6\% without checking to 40.8 % 40.8\% with lead agent checking, whereas dataset verifier checking raises it to 55.0 % 55.0\% . Across all six models, replacing lead agent checking with dataset verifier checking improves BaRe-Mem’s task completion by 11.6 % 11.6\% – 14.2 % 14.2\% points. Together, these results distinguish the complementary roles of routing and checking: reliability memory orders candidate workers, while report checking determines when to proceed to the next candidate.

This is expected, because the candidate pool is identical across routing strategies. The remaining difference is therefore not whether a solvable worker exists, but how early that worker is ranked and selected.

paragraphs.en: Obs. 1. BaRe-Mem identifies capable workers earlier. Figures 29 and 30 show that BaRe-Mem consistently achieves higher task and sub-task completion with fewer worker calls across all six lead models . The advantage is largest when only a small number of workers may be tried. With a single worker per sub-task, BaRe-Mem already outperforms routing by historical success counts for every lead model. As the worker budget increases, all methods gradually approach the same ceiling because they eventually access the same candidate pool. Therefore, the gap at smaller budgets reflects how early a capable worker is ranked and selected. BaRe-Mem reaches a larger fraction of the achievable performance with the same worker budget.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 1。 BaRe-Mem 能更早地识别出能力强的智能体。 图 29 和图 30 显示，在所有六个基础模型中，BaRe-Mem 始终能以更少的智能体调用实现更高的任务及子任务完成率。 当只能尝试少量智能体时，这种优势最为显著。 在每个子任务中仅使用一个智能体的情况下，BaRe-Mem 在每一个基础模型上的表现均已优于基于历史成功次数的路由方法。 随着可用智能体数量的增加，所有方法最终都会逐渐趋近于相同的性能上限，因为它们最终都会访问到相同的候选池。 因此，在智能体数量较少的情况下出现的差距，反映了能力强的智能体被排名和选中的时间有多早。 在相同数量的智能体预算下，BaRe-Mem 能达到更高比例的可实现性能。

sents.zh: 图 29 和图 30 显示，在所有六个基础模型中，BaRe-Mem 始终能以更少的智能体调用实现更高的任务及子任务完成率。

sents.en: The advantage is largest when only a small number of workers may be tried.
sents.zh: 当只能尝试少量智能体时，这种优势最为显著。

sents.en: With a single worker per sub-task, BaRe-Mem already outperforms routing by historical success counts for every lead model.
sents.zh: 在每个子任务中仅使用一个智能体的情况下，BaRe-Mem 在每一个基础模型上的表现均已优于基于历史成功次数的路由方法。

sents.en: As the worker budget increases, all methods gradually approach the same ceiling because they eventually access the same candidate pool.
sents.zh: 随着可用智能体数量的增加，所有方法最终都会逐渐趋近于相同的性能上限，因为它们最终都会访问到相同的候选池。

sents.en: Therefore, the gap at smaller budgets reflects how early a capable worker is ranked and selected.
sents.zh: 因此，在智能体数量较少的情况下出现的差距，反映了能力强的智能体被排名和选中的时间有多早。

sents.en: BaRe-Mem reaches a larger fraction of the achievable performance with the same worker budget.
sents.zh: 在相同数量的智能体预算下，BaRe-Mem 能达到更高比例的可实现性能。

paragraphs.en: Obs. 2. Contextual reliability improves worker ranking. The comparison with historical success counts isolates the value of contextual reliability. Success counts assign each worker a reliability based only on its aggregate past performance, whereas BaRe-Mem conditions worker reliability on the current sub-task. The consistent advantage of BaRe-Mem across all six lead models therefore shows that worker competence cannot be adequately represented by a single source-level success rate. Conditioning reliability on the current sub-task yields a more informative worker ordering, supporting the same instance-specific reliability principle used in advisor consultation.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 2。 情境可靠性提升了智能体的排名。 与历史成功次数的对比凸显了情境可靠性的价值。 成功次数仅根据每个智能体过去的总体表现来分配其可靠性，而 BaRe-Mem 则将智能体的可靠性取决于当前子任务。 因此，BaRe-Mem 在所有六个领先模型中表现出的持续优势表明，无法仅通过单一源层成功率充分反映智能体的能力。 将可靠性与当前子任务挂钩，能够生成更具信息量的智能体排序，这也支持了在顾问咨询中使用的相同实例特定可靠性原则。

paragraphs.en: We finally examine how quickly BaRe-Mem learns useful worker reliability from the online feedback stream. Following the original sub-task order, we partition the 6,404 MuSiQue sub-tasks into eight consecutive blocks of approximately 800 sub-tasks each and measure the accuracy of the initial worker selected in each block. This directly measures how the quality of the learned worker ranking evolves as verified interactions accumulate along the stream.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最终检验了 BaRe-Mem 从在线反馈流中多快能学会有关工作者的可靠性信息。 按照原始子任务的顺序，我们将 6,404 个 MuSiQue 子任务划分为八个连续区块，每个区块约包含 800 个子任务，并测量每个区块中最初选定的工作者的准确率。 这直接衡量了随着流中经过验证的交互不断积累，所学习到的工作者排序质量如何演变。

paragraphs.en: BaRe-Mem adapts rapidly from early feedback. Figure 31 shows that initial worker accuracy rises quickly during the early part of the stream for all six lead models and then remains relatively stable. Historical success counts also improve as feedback accumulates, but BaRe-Mem separates from this baseline early and maintains higher initial worker accuracy throughout the stream . In contrast, random routing remains nearly unchanged. These results show that BaRe-Mem can rapidly extract useful reliability information from early interactions.
paragraphs.zh: BaRe-Mem 能根据早期反馈迅速调整。 图 31 显示，对于所有六个领先模型，初始工作者的准确率在数据流早期阶段迅速上升，之后则保持相对稳定。 随着反馈的积累，历史成功次数也会增加，但 BaRe-Mem 很早就与这一基准线分离开来，并在整个数据流中维持更高的初始工作者准确率。 相比之下，随机路由几乎保持不变。 这些结果表明，BaRe-Mem 能够迅速从早期交互中提取有用的可靠性信息。

paragraphs.en: This adaptation pattern is also consistent with the Bayesian update in Section A.2 : when posterior uncertainty is high, the Kalman gain gives early verified outcomes greater influence, while accumulated evidence reduces uncertainty and stabilizes subsequent updates. The resulting behavior allows BaRe-Mem to adapt quickly without requiring a separate retraining stage.
paragraphs.zh: 这种适应模式也与 A.2 节中的贝叶斯更新保持一致：当后验不确定性较高时，卡尔曼增益会赋予早期验证的结果更大的影响，而累积的证据则会降低不确定性并稳定后续的更新。 由此产生的行为使 BaRe-Mem 能够快速适应，而无需单独的重新训练阶段。
